import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from probe import *
lib=build()
def case(**kw):
    c=dict(primitive='allreduce',mode=2,root=0,segments=1,words=1,capacity=8,start=0,events=[],trace=0)
    c.update(kw); return c
def D(r,p,v=[1]): return {'op':'data','rank':r,'p':p,'values':v}
def A(r,u): return {'op':'ack','rank':r,'upto':u}

print("== mode2 allreduce: U only after the receiver's own result ACK ==")

print("== mode2 broadcast: needs all three receivers ==")
evs=[D(0,0,[5])]+[A(r,1) for r in (1,2)]+[A(3,1)]
res=run(case(events=evs,primitive='broadcast',root=0),lib); show(res)
print("   expect U0=1 only after the 3rd receiver acked")

evs=[D(r,p,[r+1]) for p in range(4) for r in range(4)]
evs+=[A(0,1)]   # receiver 0 acked output q=0 (input p=0)
